facility_roles.quote: The James Ax Observatory operates in the Parque Astronómico Atacama in Northern Chile

intervals.label: observations (POLARBEAR-1 and Simons Array)
intervals.note: Start is first light of POLARBEAR-1 on the Huan Tran Telescope. End is the year LAMBDA gives for the Simons Array ("2019 - 2024"); LAMBDA does not say whether observations continued to the end of 2024.
intervals.quote: First light with the fully integrated experiment was achieved on January 10th, 2012 with a scan of Jupiter.

intervals.label: POLARBEAR-1 (Huan Tran Telescope)
intervals.note: The end is the last month of data in the published 670 deg^2 analysis ("from July 2014 to December 2016"); no source consulted states when POLARBEAR-1 observations ended, and the Simons Array receiver was deployed in 2018-2019.
intervals.quote: In subsequent years (2014-2016) the POLARBEAR survey was expanded to cover 670 square degrees of sky.

intervals.label: Simons Array (POLARBEAR-2 receivers)
intervals.note: Years only, as printed by LAMBDA.
intervals.quote: The Simons Array (2019 - 2024) consisted of an array of second generation Polarbear-2 receivers.

intervals.label: programme completed
intervals.note: LAMBDA describes the Simons Array in the past tense with the span "2019 - 2024"; it states no completion date or decommissioning, so completion is recorded at year precision. The CMB-S4 page (undated) still calls "the current POLARBEAR/Simons Array" one of the Chilean experiments.
intervals.quote: The Simons Array (2019 - 2024) consisted of an array of second generation Polarbear-2 receivers.

quantity.quote: mounted on the 2.5 m aperture Huan Tran Telescope at the James Ax Observatory
It contained 1274 antenna-coupled TES bolometers observing at 150 GHz.

name: POLARBEAR / Simons Array
notes: POLARBEAR-1 and the Simons Array are recorded as one experiment with dated phases, as the brief and LAMBDA treat them; the Simons Array's three-telescope configuration is described in arXiv:1512.07299.
The sourced end of POLARBEAR-1 is not given; see the phase interval note. The Simons Array end (2024) rests on LAMBDA alone.
No INSPIRE experiment id is recorded: INSPIRE was not contacted by this stream.

physics_goals.quote: It is designed to make measurements of the CMB polarization on small angular scales in order to detect the B-mode polarization and put limits on inflation.
physics_goals.value: Measure CMB polarization on small angular scales to detect B modes from gravitational lensing, limit inflation and reconstruct the CMB lensing potential.

summary.plain: A telescope on a Chilean mountain that, from 2012, measured the polarization of the Big Bang afterglow on small scales, found evidence that gravity bends that light, and was extended into the three-telescope Simons Array.
summary.technical: CMB polarization experiment on the 2.5 m Huan Tran Telescope at the James Ax Observatory (Cerro Toco, 5200 m): POLARBEAR-1 (first light 10 January 2012; 1274 bolometers at 150 GHz) and the Simons Array of POLARBEAR-2 receivers (2019-2024 per LAMBDA).
